title: Responsive arrow proposal
slide_intent: Carry the same spatial idea into wayfinding because orientation and identity can reinforce each other in a building.
strategic_value: Arrows shaped around words can connect Whitney’s signage to its angular graphic language.
demonstration: Four thin right-pointing arrows accommodate Whitney, Exit, Ticket Office and Stairs at different widths.
practical_value: Compare arrow proportions against label length before designing environmental signs; this is a proposal rather than evidence of installed signage.

content_islands.name: Arrow stack
content_islands.spec: Place four open angular arrows vertically with the corresponding uppercase label within each.

reference_purposes.Intent: The adjacent essay says the graphic identity and sign system should express the same values.
reference_purposes.Application: The proposal varies arrow dimensions around labels of different lengths.

ingredient.name: Responsive arrow
ingredient.role: Connect directions with the identity’s angular construction.
ingredient.application: Adapt arrow width and height to the contained words and consider applying the sign directly to the wall.
ingredient.scope: Historical signage proposal in the studio essay; not evidence that these particular signs were installed.
